solanaWallet.description: Agent's Solana wallet address (base58 public key). Used to look up on-chain identity records.

ethAddress.description: Agent's ETH address (hex, optional). Used to look up secp256k1 identity binding.

nullName.description: Agent's .null name (e.g. myagent.null). Used for identity display and routing.

rpcUrl.description: Solana RPC URL override. Defaults to solana-rpc.publicnode.com.
